title: The Episode About Guru Gobind Singh’s Movement to the South

blocks.text: This page belongs to the turning point at Talwandi Sabo when news arrives that Aurangzeb had expired. The report changes the Guru's horizon immediately, because a southern movement now becomes politically and spiritually necessary rather than merely possible.

Guru Gobind Singh speaks with Rai Dalla, weighs who will accompany the march, and prepares to leave after the long stay at Talwandi Sabo. The neighboring readable pages confirm the sequence of invitation, hesitation, taunt, and resolve that sends the narrative out of Punjab.
As a result, the page is best read as the decisive hinge between settled gathering and renewed journey. The death of the emperor opens the road, and the Guru's southward move begins in earnest.
